_doc: Dynamic N-tier LLM complexity scoring → model ladder. Score 0-10 mapped to tiers.

tiers.name: nano
tiers.description: Rule-based only, no LLM call. Simple greetings, FAQ redirect, single-word queries.

tiers.name: small
tiers.description: Lightweight model. Single-constraint product searches, simple follow-ups. qwen2.5:14b preferred: 32K context, reliable JSON output.

tiers.name: medium
tiers.description: Mid-range model. Multi-constraint queries, contextual follow-ups with budget+specs. qwen3:14b with thinking mode for structured reasoning.

tiers.name: large
tiers.description: High-capacity model with chain-of-thought. Comparisons, technical analysis, multi-turn reasoning. qwen3:30b think=true.

tiers.name: expert
tiers.description: Expert tier with full chain-of-thought. Complex multi-turn reasoning, policy questions, detailed justifications. qwen3:30b think=true.

technical_keywords.description: Technical domain keywords (GPU, VRAM, CUDA, etc.)

env_overrides.TIER_LADDER_PATH: Path to custom tier ladder JSON
